prompt.template:
The span to condense starts at “{start}” and runs to the last thing you can see.

Write one summary for later continuation, in the structure below:

## Summary of this stretch
- Goal: what this stretch of work is doing
- Artifacts: file paths, commands, config keys, quoted verbatim
- Attempts and conclusions: each attempt → feedback → why it was rejected → the final choice
- Current state:
- New caveats:

Requirements:
- Write the summary in English, even when the conversation is in another language.
- Keep file paths, commands, error strings, identifiers, numbers and function signatures verbatim.
- Record conclusions and reasons, not the process.
- Write the record directly; do not mention these requirements.

ui.expand: Click to expand the full text
ui.fragmentBadge: Part of this turn is compressed
ui.errNoModel: This session has not been routed to a model yet: pick a model in the composer, send one message, then come back and compress.
ui.errStaleRange: The selected range is no longer in the context.
ui.errEmptyHistory: This history is empty as far as the model is concerned, so there is nothing to summarize.
